   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Aug 9, 2026 - Aug 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jana Ernakovich_, Aug 10, 2026, 1/5: "horrible app. made awful changes that were not user tested and didn't revert back after thousands of user complaints. I cancelled my premium membership"
            2. _Tobey Palltor_, Aug 11, 2026, 2/5: "haven't used it in a while but found things that used to be free, like the barcode scanner are now locked behind a subscription which is pretty poor when the feature used to be free. pop ups daily asking me to subscribe. since yesterday, the app won't open and is stuck on please wait even after updating it. really not as good as I remember it being."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Aug 12, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _George Bower_, Aug 12, 2026, 1/5: "I used this app for years without missing a day, it was incredible, so user friendly, after the latest update it is an absolute unusable mess, if it does not return to it's former state or something resembling it they have lost my premium membership renewal"
            2. _Oliver_, Aug 5, 2026, 1/5: "I was actually always quite happy with the app. Very clear design and, apart from a few bugs when copying the diet to the next one, quite pleasant to use. But the new user interface is absolute hell. Who came up with that? Looks terrible"
            3. _Dorien Van Asselt_, Aug 5, 2026, 1/5: "After the latest update, this app has become horrific. The features have changed so much it is no longer the same app. It has become unusable to me. A shame after using for 8 years."
